cohort: The study included pregnant macaques (some with prior DENV infection inoculated with ZIKV, others with ZIKV only, and a control group with saline) and their infant macaques.
finding: Infant macaques exposed to both maternal DENV immunity and prenatal ZIKV had significantly worse visual orientation skills compared to ZIKV-exposed infants whose mothers were DENV-naive.
